claims.statement: The company intends to continue accelerating store openings, aiming for an average annual expansion of 10% to 20% of its base stores.
claims.quote: We have opened 50 stores last year and we hope to continue the acceleration and actually try and open as many more than we have opened in the past. Like we have always said that the right method of expansion in the offline space is to open on an average every year at least 10% to 15% or maybe 10% to 20% of your base stores – every year.

facts.statement: Avenue Supermarts reported revenue from operations of INR57,790 crores, an EBITDA margin of 7.9%, and a PAT margin of 5.1% for the year.
facts.quote: On Slide 11, we have mentioned our revenue from operations, disclosed earlier at INR57,790 crores, EBITDA margin of 7.9%, a PAT margin of 5.1% and we generated net cash from operations of INR3,700 crores plus.

facts.statement: The company added 2 million square feet of operating space and achieved a revenue from sales per square foot of about INR34,000.
facts.quote: We added 2 million square feet of operating space and our revenue from sales per square feet came at about close to INR34,000 per square feet.

facts.statement: Inventory days are close to 31 days while payables are maintained tightly at approximately 7.2 days.
facts.quote: On the days inventory, days payable, so we continue to have inventory close to 31 days and payables continue to be tight at about 7.2 days.

facts.statement: Debt-to-equity ratio is negligible because reported debt stems solely from the reclassification of AS116 lease assets.
facts.quote: Debt equity ratio is negligible because the debt that you see on the balance sheet is only due to reclassification of AS116 assets, the lease ones.

facts.statement: Standalone sales grew by 16.7%, EBITDA grew by 10.8%, and PAT excluding tax gain grew by 7.3%.
facts.quote: Moving to Slide 13, the standalone sales grew by 16.7%, EBITDA grew by 10.8% and PAT excluding tax gain grew by 7.3%.

facts.statement: DMart Ready e-commerce business operates in 24 cities after withdrawing from one city.
facts.quote: So that is why we have maintained. In fact, we are now actually in 24 cities. We have withdrawn from one city but like I said, we will talk more about that.

facts.statement: Avenue E-Commerce subsidiary grew sales by approximately 21% with a widened loss of about 7% amounting to INR247 crores.
facts.quote: Avenue E-Commerce grew sales by about 21% and the loss slightly widened to about 7%, the loss was at INR247 crores.
